title: Office of Science and Technology Policy: Phase 56O Remediation Follow-Through — Phase 65 AI for science review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the AI for science reporting pack. GAO reports that OSTP implemented three of six prior priority recommendations, added one, and now has four priority recommendations focused on national science-and-technology goals and research security. Phase 56O decision: Publish the exact portfolio movement while keeping national-goal tracking and research-security information sharing separate.
key_findings: Exact record: GAO-26-109139 OSTP priority recommendation portfolio.
Status period: June 2025 baseline through June 2026.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO publishes the next OSTP priority letter or a named current recommendation changes status.
why_it_matters: Which records connect compute, data, evaluation, and program support to institutional adoption, reproduced scientific work, and measured research outcomes? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The record exposes implementation throughput and remaining remediation workload without converting a portfolio into a performance rate.
ftfn_relevance: Keeps implemented, added, de-prioritized, current, modeled, and realized states distinct.
Attaches source, period, scope, limitation, remaining gap, and continuation rule.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.

The portfolio covers national science-and-technology planning and research security. Implementation counts do not measure research output, innovation quality, security effectiveness, or national readiness.
Action-level closure evidence for the four current priorities and measured outcomes from national-goal tracking or research-security coordination.
No ranking, composite, readiness score, performance rate, or causal claim is supported.
